title: No more connection when ending Nano (and DASH) pods
body:
This happened 3 times with the deactivation of the Nano pod. Looks like deactivation terminated ok but seconds later, I get this "pod basal injection" error.

![Screenshot_20250702_185650_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/217e69ca-42b1-41aa-a51b-c017b4047c8a)

The logs. Look around 18:57

@TheNeskik Can you add logs next time you change a pod and the error happens please ? When did this started ? I think mine started with the last dev.

I'm having this issue this last dev update too.

![AndroidAPS._2025-07-01_19-36-01_.10.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21031067/AndroidAPS._2025-07-01_19-36-01_.10.zip)

Issue appear when I'm starting a new pod
Issue around 22h36 on my log file, line 4934

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1751661223601.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21067712/AndroidAPS_LOG_1751661223601.log.zip)

Just changed my pod.
No error on deactivate state but got two error during activation.
First just before priming
Second just before cannula insert.

Cleaned my log just before changing my pod so log is cleaner :)

Just changed my Nano with extreme attention to detail 😉

I deactivated the pod, came to the _Ok / Next_ choice window. Hit OK to "not start" the new pod. I got the same _pump unreachable/basal not set_ alert.

So, AFA Nano is concerned, the no connection alert comes at the end of the pod deactivation (and not when starting the new one).

After _OK_ ing the alert window, I started the new pod normally, without any problems or alerts.

@robertrub Confirming: seeing the same

(latest AAPS-dev commits...)

Have you found which commit is the root cause of this issue?
Or at least what was the previous version/commit without the issue?
It started with the last dev. I'm on vacation (Dordogne,  superbe 🤩) and without any PC 🥰

I've also encountered this error a few times now when replacing a Dash Pod.

After reviewing the log files, I noticed that the RunningMode is set to SUSPENDED_BY_PUMP during the activation of the new Pod. However, even while the Pod is still in its activation phase — during which it shouldn't accept any commands — a CANCEL TEMPBASAL command is being sent.

This results in the Pod is in an incorrect state error, which makes sense because programming commands aren't allowed until activation is fully completed.

I'm not a very frequent tester of the dev branch, so I can't say exactly when this started. However, I saw that the RunningMode system was introduced in the following commit

https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/2e85d3be06e437d788d53b2c36aa72ffbf1d349e

Could it be that this issue is related to the changes introduced in that commit?
